max_tire.note: On 15x8 wheels with healthy springs. Owners say 32x11.50 is the limit on sagging springs, and 33x14.50s rubbed the springs on one truck. Expect contact off-road at full stuff.
One CK5 owner ran 35s on a 4 in lift on the highway, but warns that 4 in isn't enough off-road once the axle articulates.
A 5 in Tuff Country lift runs 33s with no rubbing. The owner thought 35s would fit but would need gears deeper than the stock 3.73s.

timeline.change: K5 Blazer launches as a 4x4 only. 250 six, 307 and 350 V8s; four-wheel drum brakes; hardtop, soft top and passenger seat all optional. Aluminum grille center embossed CHEVROLET, bowtie on the hood. 4,935 built
Two-wheel-drive Blazer with coil-spring IFS (fewer than 1,000 built that year per CK5). GMC Jimmy introduced. 292 six optional. New grille with six groups of 'dashes'
Power front disc brakes standard across GM light trucks. Egg-crate grille, length grows to 180 in
292 six dropped; 350 rated at 175 net hp. Grille surround no longer black. Production jumps to 44,266
Replaced by the square-body K5 on the new Rounded Line chassis, which kept a fully removable top until 1975

identify.intro: Four model years, a GMC twin and decades of engine swaps and reproduction parts mean the details matter, especially on high-dollar 'original' trucks.

items.head: First gen vs square body
items.body: 1969–72 trucks use the Action Line pickup front end and body on a 104 in wheelbase. 1973–75 square bodies also have a full removable top, but sit on a 106.5 in wheelbase with the new 1973 sheet metal.

items.head: Year by grille
items.body: Per CK5: 1969 has an aluminum center piece embossed CHEVROLET with built-in rectangular parking lamps; 1970 has six groups of silver 'dashes'; 1971 has an egg-crate grille; on 1972 the grille surround is no longer black. Grilles are easy to swap, so cross-check the title year and VIN.

items.head: SPID decal
items.body: The Service Parts Identification decal inside the glovebox lists factory options and paint (BaT 1969 listing). Use it to check CST trim, Positraction and engine claims.

items.head: GMC Jimmy series codes
items.body: GMC's 1971 brochure lists the Jimmy as CE-1550 and CS-1550 (two-wheel drive) and KE-1550 and KS-1550 (4x4).

items.head: Transfer case and brakes
items.body: Manual trucks may have a Dana 20 or an NP205; automatics have the NP205 (one-piece iron case, three-bolt idler cover, tag above the front output). Front discs are original only on 1971–72 trucks.

capability.note: 1969 spec sheet; the 1971 sheet lists 21 gal

values.intro: Prices are firm and rising. Unrusted original trucks, CST and Cheyenne trim, the V8 and four-speed command the most, and resto-mods with modern engines sell for more again.
values.note: Based on 34 Bring a Trailer sales of 1969–72 Blazers and 1970–72 Jimmys, March 2025 to October 2026. The 18 unmodified trucks sold for $23,750–100,000, median about $47,000. GMC Jimmys usually sell for less than equivalent Chevrolets.
